summary: Iteration 3 verifies the smoothness bug fix (Reanimated UI-thread motion) + full-stack regression. Backend: 13/13 pytest cases pass (health returns 'Plum Peach API'; POST /api/scores basic/empty→Guest/whitespace→Guest/16-char truncate/negative-clamp/persistence; GET /api/scores/top sort desc, limit clamp, no _id; GET /api/scores/rank shape, high-score=1, missing 422). Frontend (390x844 web preview) VERIFIED: (a) game-screen loads with no red-screen and NO reanimated/worklet/useFrameCallback errors (0 console errors observed); (b) FRUITS ACTUALLY MOVE DOWN — measured 9/14 fruits shifted top>5px between two captures ~900ms apart (matches speedFor(0)=70 px/s); (c) motion RESUMES smoothly after retry (9/14 moved post-retry); (d) miss game-over overlay auto-triggers on inactivity; (e) score submit → 'Submitted to ranking!'; (f) retry-button clears overlay & resets score to 0; (g) wrong-tap on non-lowest fruit immediately triggers gameover-overlay; (h) overlay-ranking-button navigates to ranking-screen which lists 35 rank-row-N entries. Only console noise = pre-existing RN-Web deprecation warnings for shadow* and pointerEvents (cosmetic). No Japanese text, no red screen, no crashes.

issues: Pre-existing (non-blocking) console warnings: 'shadow* style props are deprecated. Use boxShadow'.
Pre-existing (non-blocking) console warnings: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'.

action_items: (Optional cosmetic) Replace shadow* style props with boxShadow / Platform.select to silence RN-Web deprecation warnings.
(Optional cosmetic) Move pointerEvents from prop to style.pointerEvents in index.tsx sun View and any FallingField overlays.

(Optional cleanup) game.tsx still keeps unused legacy styles (lane/string/stack/bead/targetBead/catchLine, fruitBtnInner/fruitBtnLabel/meterRow/meterLabel/turboLabel/barTrack/barFill) after refactor — safe to remove.
critical_code_review_comments: Smoothness fix is correctly implemented on the UI thread: useFrameCallback worklet advances a shared 'travel' value each frame; FallingFruit uses useAnimatedStyle so React does NOT re-render per frame. Spawn/pop still happens on JS via a 90ms setInterval reading travel.value — acceptable trade-off; verified no lag or worklet errors on web.

Miss detection is frame-accurate via useAnimatedReaction on running.value && travel.value > missThreshold.value, and hops back to JS via runOnJS(handleMiss) — correct and idempotent (stop() flips running.value=false so it fires only once).
recomputeMiss() is called after every spawn and after every successful press, keeping missThreshold in sync with the current lowest fruit — correct.
restart() properly resets travel/speed/score/list, clears bursts, sets running true and re-creates the 90ms spawn interval; stop() clears interval and both running flags — no leak.
Burst uses withTiming with runOnJS(onDone) to remove itself — no orphaned particle nodes.
Backend: response models exclude _id via projection ({_id:0}) and Pydantic Score model; name defaults to 'Guest' and truncates to 16; negative score clamps to 0.
Frontend uses process.env.EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL correctly; every interactive element has testID; StyleSheet.create used throughout; all text wrapped in <Text>.
No deprecated Expo packages (expo-av / expo-barcode-scanner / expo-background-fetch) are imported.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of deterministic flows (motion, miss, wrong-tap, submit, retry, navigation)
